notes: No click events were intentionally dispatched.
Focus states can generally be reproduced programmatically.
Synthetic mouse events can trigger JavaScript event handlers.
Browsers do not guarantee that synthetic mouse events activate the native CSS :hover pseudo-class.
CSS :hover rules are therefore extracted separately from stylesheets.
